name: Vocus DC-PER05 Osborne Park data centre
notes: Vocus lists Perth metro colocation facilities and its colocation brochure identifies DC-PER05 in Osborne Park; aggregate listings place the facility at 43 King Edward Road, Osborne Park, within City of Stirling. No public MW capacity found.

name: DC Two Osborne Park micro data centre
notes: DC Two describes a network of regional and edge data centres. Trade coverage around the public listing identified DC Two's Osborne Park site in Perth as a 200kW micro data centre.

name: GlobalEdge/Data Centre Limited Balcatta data centre
notes: Aggregate facility listings and PeeringDB identify a carrier-neutral data centre at 247 Balcatta Road, Balcatta, within City of Stirling. Primary/current operator detail is limited, so capacity and current operating details are unverified.

name: Equinix PE2 Perth IBX data centre
notes: Equinix lists PE2 as an operational Perth IBX facility at 37 Lemnos Street, Shenton Park. The site is in/adjacent to the City of Subiaco locality; no public utility MW capacity was found.

name: Equinix PE3 Perth IBX data centre
notes: Equinix launched PE3 in Shenton Park as its third Perth IBX. DCD reported the launch in December 2020 and Equinix continues to list PE3 as an active Perth data centre.

name: NEXTDC P1 Perth data centre and Stage 2 expansion
notes: NEXTDC P1 is an operational Perth facility in Malaga, City of Swan. Multiplex/NEXTDC material says Stage 2 will add roughly 5,000 sqm and support up to 12MW total planned IT capacity, with completion targeted in 2026.

name: Fujitsu Malaga data centre
notes: Fujitsu lists Australian data centre services and aggregate/PeeringDB facility data identifies the Malaga facility at 16 Mulgul Road, Malaga, within City of Swan. No public MW capacity found.

name: HostAway Malaga data centre
notes: HostAway says it operates Perth data centre services from its Malaga facility; facility directories and PeeringDB identify the data centre at 8 Midas Road, Malaga, within City of Swan.

name: GreenSquareDC Perth hyperscale data centre, Hazelmere
notes: The WA Government announced approval in February 2025 for a $1bn, 120MW Hazelmere data centre in City of Swan, but DCD later reported GreenSquareDC pulled out and the site was to be sold. Coded rejected to indicate this project did not proceed under the announced developer.
